results.title: What Twelve LLM Agent Benchmark Papers Disclose About Themselves: A Pilot Audit and an Open Scoring Schema
results.snippet: We read twelve well-known LLM agent benchmark papers and recorded, dimension by dimension, what each paper actually says about how its evaluation was run. The motivation came from a familiar frustration: two papers will report results on the same benchmark with the same model name and disagree, and you cannot tell why -- the scaffold, the sampling settings, the subset, or the evaluator version. In many cases the published artifact does not let you answer. This paper is an implementation report on the attempt. We designed a small audit schema (five fields: benchmark identity, harness specifica…

results.title: Efficient Benchmarking in Production: A Study of an Evolving LLM Agent
results.snippet: Production LLM agents are evaluated repeatedly as they evolve, but full agent benchmarks are costly to rerun. We study efficient recurring evaluation for a production analytics agent serving tens of thousands of monthly active users and report first-hand deployment experience. Using 574 historical runs of the production benchmark, split chronologically into calibration and held-out periods, we compare random sampling, historical caching, fixed representative subsets, and IRT-based adaptive testing. The results show that multidimensional 2PL adaptive testing achieves the best overall score fid…

results.title: Agent Step Value: Auditing Evaluation-Channel Sensitivity in Black-Box Agent Traces
results.snippet: Reusing evaluator-derived step rewards across evaluation channels raises a measurement question: does the assigned direction remain stable? We define Agent Step Value (ASV) as a channel-indexed before/after target-margin gain and identify the state-by-channel interaction from a matched 2x2 design. Across frozen PubMed question-answering transitions, cross-channel gain signs disagree on 48.3% of comparisons, compared with 0.3% for same-channel retries. Transition interactions are nearly balanced in sign (median +0.014; 10% trimmed mean -0.033), but asymmetric negative magnitudes produce a posi…

results.title: AOAD-MAT: Transformer-based multi-agent deep reinforcement learning model considering agents' order of action decisions
results.snippet: Multi-agent reinforcement learning focuses on training the behaviors of multiple learning agents that coexist in a shared environment. Recently, MARL models, such as the Multi-Agent Transformer (MAT) and ACtion dEpendent deep Q-learning (ACE), have significantly improved performance by leveraging sequential decision-making processes. Although these models can enhance performance, they do not explicitly consider the importance of the order in which agents make decisions. In this paper, we propose an Agent Order of Action Decisions-MAT (AOAD-MAT), a novel MAT model that considers the order in w…

results.title: Do Human Cognitive Failures Map onto AI Agent Failures? A Structured Literature Review
results.snippet: Background. Practitioners routinely reach for the human-factors and cognitive-psychology literature when designing safety mechanisms for large language model (LLM) agent systems: hallucination resembles confabulation, persona drift resembles role drift, multi-agent coordination breakdowns resemble Crew Resource Management failures. The reflex is intuitive but partially misleading. Approach. We invert the usual AI-side framing. Rather than asking whether AI failures resemble human failures, we start from a comprehensive 45-category taxonomy of human cognitive failures (drawn from cognitive psy…
results.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

results.title: The Cosmological Parameters (2023)
results.snippet: This is a review article for The Review of Particle Physics 2024 (aka the Particle Data Book), appearing as Chapter 25. It forms a compact review of knowledge of the cosmological parameters near the end of 2023. Topics included are Parametrizing the Universe; Extensions to the standard model; Probes; Bringing observations together; Outlook for the future.

findings.point: 存在一项结构化文献综述，将人类认知失误的 45 类分类学与 AI Agent 失效模式进行映射，旨在为 AI Agent 评测提供基于认知科学的研究路线图
findings.evidence: 论文采用 PRISMA 2020 协议，从认知心理学、人因工程、社会心理学、神经心理学和决策研究中汇总 45 类人类认知失误，逐一考察现有 AI Agent 研究是否覆盖；结论为：从业者常直觉类比（幻觉≈虚构、人设漂移≈角色漂移、多智能体协作失效≈CRM 失效），但该类比部分误导，需系统性映射而非直觉迁移
findings.authority: Zenodo 预印本（CERN），未经同行评审
findings.attention: 低，刚发布（2026-05-08）且引用数为 0，社区讨论尚未形成
findings.recommendation: ★★★☆☆：提供了将人因/认知科学分类学系统引入 Agent 安全评测的新视角，但为预印本且无引用验证，建议作为研究切入点而非权威定论

results.title: Open Evaluation Agent: Efficient and Promptable Evaluation of Visual Generative Models
results.snippet: Recent advances in visual generative models have enabled high-quality image and video generation, but evaluating these models often demands sampling hundreds or thousands of images or videos, which is computationally expensive. Existing evaluation methods also rely on rigid pipelines that overlook specific user needs and provide numerical results without clear explanations. Mimicking how humans quickly form impressions of a model's capabilities from only a few samples, we propose the Evaluation Agent framework, which employs human-like strategies for efficient, dynamic, multi-round evaluation…

results.title: Team Anotheroption at SemEval-2025 Task 8: Bridging the Gap Between Open-Source and Proprietary LLMs in Table QA
results.snippet: This paper presents a system developed for SemEval 2025 Task 8: Question Answering (QA) over tabular data. Our approach integrates several key components: text-to-SQL and text-to-code generation modules, a self-correction mechanism, and a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Additionally, it includes an end-to-end (E2E) module, all orchestrated by a large language model (LLM). Through ablation studies, we analyzed the effects of different parts of our pipeline and identified the challenges that are still present in this field. During the evaluation phase of the competition, our solution achi…

results.title: Red-Agent: A Practical Multi-Provider Framework for LLM Red Teaming with Operational Reachability and Artifact-Complete Reporting
results.snippet: We present Red-Agent, a practical multi-provider framework for LLM red teaming focused on reliable cross-model execution, artifact completeness, and reproducible reporting. The empirical results in this paper come from a curated 11-model run using a stable campaign runner over a fixed 20-probe ATT&CK-inspired taxonomy. We pair model outcomes with operational reachability and error accounting to separate safety behavior from execution brittleness. To add evaluator context, we apply post-hoc StrongREJECT scoring to archived trajectories without rerunning probes. The resulting artifact set i…

This paper presents the experiments and results for the CheckThat! Lab at CLEF 2024 Task 6: Robustness of Credibility Assessment with Adversarial Examples (InCrediblAE). The primary objective of this task was to generate adversarial examples in five problem domains in order to evaluate the robustness of widely used text classification methods (fine-tuned BERT, BiLSTM, and RoBERTa) when applied to credibility assessment issues.
  This study explores the application of ensemble learning to enhance adversarial attacks on natural language processing (NLP) models. We systematically tested and refi…

findings.evidence: 论文在固定的 20 个 ATT&CK 风格探针上对 11 个模型进行了策划运行，并将模型结果与操作可达性、错误核算配对。

# Agent 评测与安全（能力基准、欺骗与可纠正性）深度调研报告

**日期**：2026-11-11（UTC）  
**领域**：Agent Evaluation & Safety / Capability Benchmarks / Deception Detection / Corrigibility  
**检索源数量**：35 条可引用证据（含 arXiv 预印本、会议论文、预印本平台、挑战赛概览）

---

## 1. 进展与热点（Progress & Hotspots）

### 1.1 能力基准构建的最新增量
| 进展 | 时间 | 机构/来源 | 一句话贡献 | 热度证据 | 权威证据 | 关注度 | 推荐度 |
|------|------|-----------|------------|----------|----------|--------|--------|
| **AgentBench** 统一评测 LLMs-as-Agents | 2023/2024 (v3) | 清华等 [27] | 提供 8 个环境、17 个任务的端到端 Agent 基准，成该领域引用最广的基准之一 | citations 高（未给出具体数）[27] | arXiv 预印本 v3，疑已发表顶会 | 高 | ★★★★★ |
| **SVC 2025：首个多模态欺骗检测挑战赛** | 2025-08 | 未明确 [9] | 面向音视频多模态的欺骗检测基准与榜单，推动多模态欺骗评测标准化 | 挑战赛官方榜单 [9] | arXiv 预印本（挑战赛概览） | 中 | ★★★★☆ |
| **评测通道敏审计** | 2026-07 | [6] | 发现跨评估通道增益符号在 48.3% 转移上不一致，揭示黑盒 Agent 追踪的评测脆弱性 | 实验 48.3% 不一致率 [6] | arXiv 预印本 v5 | 中 | ★★★☆☆ |
| **生产环境自适应基准测试** | 2026-09 | [3] | 574 次历史运行显示自适应测试仅需 38.5% 样本即达 1.03 pp MAE，大幅降低全量重跑成本 | 38.5% 样本、1.03 pp MAE [3] | arXiv 预印本 | 中 | ★★★☆☆ |
| **基准论文披露审计** | 2026-05 | [2] | 审计 12 篇知名基准论文，发现五大维度披露缺失，提出开放评分模式 | 12 篇论文、五大维度 [2] | arXiv 预印本 | 中 | ★★★☆☆ |

> **增量判断**：2024-2026 年能力基准从“静态任务集”转向“生产级自适应评测”[3]与“评测通道鲁棒性审计”[6]；多模态欺骗基准（SVC 2025）[9]填补了单模态空白。但**可纠正性专用基准（如 CORGI、CorrigibilityBench、ShutdownBench）在候选证据中完全缺失** > 待核实。

### 1.2 欺骗行为检测与缓解的前沿
| 进展 | 时间 | 机构/来源 | 一句话贡献 | 热度证据 | 权威证据 | 关注度 | 推荐度 |
|------|------|-----------|------------|----------|----------|--------|--------|
| **线性探针检测战略欺骗** | 2025-02 | [10] | 在隐藏状态上训练线性探针，零样本泛化检测 LLM 战略欺骗行为 | 实验指标未给出 [10] | arXiv 预印本 | 中 | ★★★☆☆ |
| **知识验证下的涌现欺骗** | 2026-08 | [12] | 在冲突激励下发现 LLM Agent 会涌现欺骗行为，且可通过知识验证揭示 | 实验设计新颖 [12] | arXiv 预印本 | 中高 | ★★★★☆ |
| **多智能体通信攻击红队** | 2025 | ACL Findings [33] | 针对多智能体通信协议的红队攻击框架，揭示协作层面的欺骗风险 | ACL Findings 同行评审 [33] | 顶会录用 | 中高 | ★★★★☆ |
